name: @w6w-apps/luma
description: Manage events, guests and ticket types on a Luma calendar.

w6w.longDescription:
Luma runs a calendar's events end to end from a workflow: create, update, cancel and read events; manage ticket types, including paid ones on a calendar with a connected Stripe account; add, invite, approve, decline, waitlist and re-ticket guests; and add or remove event hosts.

Each connection is scoped to exactly one calendar, matching how Luma issues API keys — the calendar a workflow acts on is whichever calendar the connected key was generated for, with no separate calendar-id field to get wrong. Calendar-level actions cover the calendar's own settings, its admins, its contact list, and reviewing events submitted to it (list, look up, approve or reject a pending submission).

A fit for syncing registrations into a CRM, automating check-in or waitlist promotion logic Luma's own dashboard doesn't offer, keeping a calendar's contact list in sync with an external list, or triggering follow-up workflows off guest status changes. This app covers events, guest/registration management, ticket types, hosts, calendar administration and contacts as documented in Luma's public OpenAPI 3.1 spec; it does not cover coupons, event/contact tags, webhooks, memberships, organizations or image uploads — none of those were verified against the live API for this build.
